summary.text: Emilia Sykes is the Democratic incumbent in Ohio's 13th Congressional District, which she has represented since January 2023. An Akron native and attorney, she served eight years in the Ohio House, including as House Minority Leader, before winning her congressional seat in 2022. She sits on the Transportation and Infrastructure and Science, Space, and Technology committees.

paragraphs.text: Born January 4, 1986, in Akron, Ohio, where she was raised; graduated from Firestone High School. She is the daughter of Vernon and Barbara Sykes, who held the same Ohio House seat before her.
Earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from Kent State University (graduating with honors), and a Juris Doctor and a Master of Public Health from the University of Florida.
Worked as a law clerk to the chief judge of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Georgia and as an administrative advisor in the Summit County fiscal office.

Won the Ohio House (34th District) seat in 2014, taking office in January 2015, to succeed her father, who was term-limited, after winning the Democratic primary over Summit County councilman Frank Communale.
Served eight years in the Ohio House, including four years in Democratic leadership and three as House Minority Leader, according to her official biography.
Won the November 2022 general election for Ohio's 13th District over Republican Madison Gesiotto Gilbert, and was re-elected in 2024 over Republican Kevin Coughlin, 51.1% to 48.9%.
In Congress she serves on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, where she is Vice Ranking Member, and on the Science, Space, and Technology Committee.

Her official biography lists recognitions including the Rising Star Award from EMILY's List and the Champion for Children Award from Summit County Children's Services, and states she is married to Kevin Boyce.
